messages:
Andrea: @here Liam's turning 29 next Wed. Quick poll — singalong in the kitchen at 3pm (:microphone:) or a short quiet toast + coffee table in the cafe at 3pm (:coffee:)? Remote folks we'll open Zoom for a 2‑min toast. Vote with reactions (:microphone: = singalong, :coffee: = quiet toast).
Zack: Is there a GF/vegan option if we do food? I'm allergic to nuts.
Andrea: Yep — will order GF cupcakes + vegan muffin options and label allergens.
Devon: I can bring my guitar if people actually want the singalong :guitar:. I promise soft volume.
Maria: For remote folks can we start at 2:50 so people can hop on before 3? Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.example/ld29
Riley: Can we do both? 2‑min Zoom toast for remote, then in‑office singalong for those present?
Andrea: Love that—Plan B accepted. Zoom 2:50–2:52 for remote toast, in‑person singalong at 3.
Flo: Low‑key please, I have a sore throat :grimacing:. I'll opt out of singing but will clap.
Riley: +1 to low‑key. I'll sing quietly :wink:.
Devon: I'll keep it mellow. Also can we have a "no‑pressure" sign for those who want to skip?
Andrea: Yep, totally optional. I'll print a sign and set expectations so no one feels put on the spot.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Liam's 29th — Toast + Optional Singalong" 2026‑06‑02 14:50–15:15. Guests: people‑ops, eng, marketing.
Zack: Thanks Andrea! I'll add GF label stickers to the order sheet.
Maria: If anyone wants to drop a short voice note or birthday message for Liam (remote), DM me and I'll compile a little clip.
Andrea: Thanks all — reactions are the official votes. Current (manual) tally: :microphone: 3, :coffee: 4.
